- [Elasticsearch](https://www.elastic.co/elasticsearch/) - Elasticsearch provides vector search via kNN plugin with HNSW/IVF, hybrid lexical+vector (BM25+ANN), and Lucene-based dense retrieval. Ideal for enterprise search with aggregations and security. Outperforms Vespa in ecosystem integrations but heavier than lightweight DBs like Qdrant.
